writeKey.description: API key used for write purposes. For `BATTERY_INCLUDED`, this key is validated before the configuration is created or updated.

excludedMixinKeys.description: Optional list of root product mixin keys to exclude from indexing. When set, the specified mixin keys are omitted from both the non-localized and localized portions of the indexed document. Applies only to the `BATTERY_INCLUDED` provider.

includedMixinPaths.description:
Optional allowlist of product mixin paths to include in indexing for the `BATTERY_INCLUDED` provider. Patterns are matched against full dot-notation paths rooted at the mixin key, for example `class_EA673_toolsClassification.sk.OnlineIsService_P`.
`*` matches within a single path segment, `**` matches across one or more path segments, and matching is case sensitive.
If a matched path points to an object, the entire subtree under that object is included. When this field is absent or an empty list, path filtering is inactive and existing `excludedMixinKeys` behavior applies.
`includedMixinPaths` and `excludedMixinKeys` are mutually exclusive when `includedMixinPaths` is non-empty. Malformed glob patterns are rejected with a validation error on configuration writes.

searchKey.description: API Key used for search purposes.

applicationId.description: Application id of an indexer provider.

provider.description: Index provider name. Supported providers: `ALGOLIA` (https://www.algolia.com), `BATTERY_INCLUDED` (https://www.batteryincluded.io). Only one provider can be active per tenant at a time.

active.description: Indicates if the configuration is active or not.
